evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics/provenance review for the live canonical record.
findings: 100–500-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ125. The initial use fires two Ki balls and repeated input extends the barrage; current dedicated evidence documents a 2–13-hit range and long-range projectile behavior, with source-reported damage of about 6% for the initial two hits and additional damage across the extended sequence. Exact per-hit scaling and timing remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.

Known source conflicts or historical evidence are retained as provenance rather than silently normalized.
